# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated, read-only directory of 5,855 AI agent tools in 40 categories, including 3,190 MCP servers. Checked daily, 3,175 of 3,187 checked servers live, last checked 2026-11-14. +3 listed, not yet checked. Handshake check: 1,400 of 1,767 remote servers checked so far. Of those, 458 answered with a tools list, 924 asked for auth, 18 failed. This is the initialize + tools/list probe, updated daily around 7:15 AM Pacific, separate from the link check around 7 AM PT. Listings are link-checked daily; pricing is as makers state it. Featured slots are clearly labeled and sit above the list; rankings are never paid. This file tells AI agents and assistants how to use the directory.

<!-- mcp-reach:start -->

## MCP server reachability

Checked daily, 3,175 of 3,187 checked servers live, last checked 2026-11-14. +3 listed, not yet checked.

Handshake check: 1,400 of 1,767 remote servers checked so far. Of those, 458 answered with a tools list, 924 asked for auth, 18 failed. This is the initialize + tools/list probe, updated daily around 7:15 AM Pacific, separate from the link check around 7 AM PT.

Once a day, AgentScout requests every MCP server in the directory, including catalog-only listings, and, when it is a different link, its GitHub URL. The request is HEAD, then GET, with a 20-second timeout. If that fails on TLS or gets no response, it retries once with a browser user agent. A server counts as live when its stored label is OK or Reachable, blocks automated checks. OK is HTTP 200-399 or 405, and also 401, 403 or 429 when the GitHub URL succeeded or that URL is the only one checked. Reachable, blocks automated checks means those 401, 403 or 429 responses without a harder error. Any other checked result is not live. The live percentage uses only servers with a row in the check file: live plus down. A server with no row is listed, not yet checked, and is not part of that percentage. Catalog-only listings stay unverified until that daily check opens them. The last-checked time is the checked field, in America/Los_Angeles. The rows are on the MCP status page and in status.json.

- [MCP server status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/status/): the same reachability rows, with HTTP result and history
- [status.json](https://agentscouthq.com/status.json): machine-readable rows for every listed MCP server
- [Best MCP servers by task](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/): ranked lists, with the same daily check

<!-- mcp-reach:end -->

Entity note: AgentScout (also searched as Agent Scout or AgentScoutHQ) is the independent AI agent and MCP server directory at https://agentscouthq.com, published in the official MCP Registry as com.agentscouthq/directory with endpoint https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp. AgentScout's official MCP server (com.agentscouthq/directory at https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp) is 100% free, public, and read-only, with no API key, crypto wallet, or x402 payment required. It is completely unrelated to the paid third-party x402 web-fetch package that shares a similar name.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ, https://x.com/clampdown19

MCP Endpoint: https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (and https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp — 100% free, read-only, no API key or x402 wallet required)
Catalog last checked: 2026-11-15 (Pacific)

## For AI agents

- Fastest path: fetch [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json) once and filter it locally. No key, no rate-limited API, plain HTTPS GET.
- api/tools.json is an object with `count`, `last_checked` (YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific) and `tools`, an array where each tool has `name`, `slug`, `category`, `description`, `url`, `website`, `github`, `pricing` (maker's wording), `price_tag` (free / freemium / paid), `platforms`, `open_source`, `license`, `github_stars`, `tags`, `added` and `page` (its AgentScout listing).
- To cite a tool, link its `page` (https://agentscouthq.com/tools/<slug>.html). To cite a category, use the category links below.
- Treat `pricing` as the maker's own claim on the date shown; it can change. GitHub stars are refreshed daily.
- Everything here is read-only. There is no chat, search or write endpoint for agents; to list a tool, a person uses the submit form.

## Update cadence

- New tools: added most days; see the Recently added section below and new.html.
- Links: checked daily (`last_checked` in api/tools.json).
- MCP pricing and link-status tables: rebuilt with every site update, each with a dated change history.
- GitHub stars: snapshot daily.
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml) carries a per-page lastmod.

## Machine-readable catalog

- [llms-full.txt](https://agentscouthq.com/llms-full.txt): single-file Markdown context with category comparison tables and all 3,190 verified MCP servers (pricing, link status, runs_locally, license, stars, endpoints)
- [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json): full catalog with counts and check date
- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): same tools in the site's internal format
- [api/products.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/products.json): Stripe Agentic Commerce product feed for maker listing packages ($0, $15, $49, $99/wk) and Made by AgentScout pre-trained bots (also at [.well-known/acp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/acp.json))
- [.well-known/ai-plugin.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): AI plugin manifest with prompt-engineered model instructions
- [openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.json) & [openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1 JSON & YAML descriptions of the feeds under /api/ (also at [.well-known/openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.json) and [.well-known/openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.yaml))
- [manifest.json](https://agentscouthq.com/manifest.json): Web app brand manifest with icons and theme colors
- [.well-known/mcp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/mcp.json): MCP server card pointing to https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp
- [.well-known/agent-card.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): agent card describing this directory (also at /.well-known/agent.json)
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages
- [feed.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/feed.xml): RSS 2.0 of the latest tools and agent news

Optional runs_locally filter: offline, self_hosted_or_offline or any; locality is inferred from listings, so verify with the vendor before relying on it for compliance

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)
- Tools added in the last 2 days (2026-11-14 to 2026-11-15): 71

- [Grok Bot](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/grok-bot.html) (added 2026-11-15): Grok Bot is an AI teammate product from SpaceXAI (formerly xAI) in which each named Bot gets its own persistent cloud computer with a browser, filesystem and terminal. You message Bots like colleagues in the desktop and mobile apps, Slack or Microsoft Teams; they sign in to your apps and websites, including ones with no API, work in parallel around the clock, hand off to each other and ask for approval before sensitive steps. Finished methods can be saved as skills and run as routines on a schedule or when an event arrives. Grok Bot 1.0 left beta on Nov 2, 2026, and it is included in The X Subscription Premium ($30/mo), Super ($100/mo) and Ultra ($200/mo) plans, with Teams seats and Enterprise.
- [FestiveLooks](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/festivelooks.html) (added 2026-11-15): FestiveLooks is an AI holiday photo generator that turns one uploaded photo into seasonal portraits of you, your family, your partner or your pet while keeping faces recognisable. Christmas is live with 20 looks plus tools such as adding Santa to a photo, dog Christmas portraits and a Christmas filter, with New Year, Valentine's Day and other holidays coming. Subscriptions start at $14.99 a month for 100 credits, with full-size watermark-free downloads.
- [Tesla Wrap Design](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/tesla-wrap-design.html) (added 2026-11-15): Tesla Wrap Design is a free browser studio for creating custom wraps for Tesla's Paint Shop feature: you pick one of 12 official vehicle templates, paint with layers, stickers, text and brushes, check the result on a live 3D model and export a PNG to load from a USB drive, all without an account. An optional AI generator turns a text prompt into a wrap design for 10 credits, with credit packs from $4.90 that never expire.
- [MOSS-Image Online](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/moss-image-online.html) (added 2026-11-15): MOSS-Image Online is a hosted web generator for OpenMOSS's open 5B MOSS-Image model, which is known for spelling Chinese and English text correctly inside images such as posters, menus and signs and for following box-level layouts you draw. You describe the picture and the exact words, optionally place elements in a layout editor, and get three free images before one-time credit packs from $4.99; it also links ComfyUI workflows and lets you run on your own Hugging Face quota.
- [Oh!Mate](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/oh-mate.html) (added 2026-11-15): Oh!Mate is a desktop AI workspace for Windows, macOS and Linux that edits Word documents, Excel spreadsheets and PowerPoint decks for you while leaving untouched content and formatting as it was. Work is organised into project workspaces with your files, sources and chat sessions, and reusable Skills cover tasks such as writing, data cleanup, PDFs, slides, research notes, code and long-form fiction. Free and paid plans are available; an account and internet connection are required.
- [SoloPup Memory](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/solopup-memory.html) (added 2026-11-15): SoloPup Memory is an MIT-licensed text-memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that stores what you tell your coding agent together with the original wording and its source, keeps memories separated by project and records a revision history, so the agent can recall decisions with evidence instead of paraphrased guesses. It is in public beta.
- [Duct AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/duct-ai.html) (added 2026-11-15): Duct is an open-source (MIT) AI marketing agent that acts as a growth analyst with access to all your tools at once. It reads Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, Search Console, Stripe, Mixpanel and other sources together, explains why a number moved across them, and drafts fixes such as pausing or resuming a campaign that only run when you press Apply. It is a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that uses your own model key or an existing ChatGPT plan.
- [Kite.new](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/kite-new.html) (added 2026-11-15): Kite is a design canvas where AI agents and people work on the same board: Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or another agent you already pay for designs screens, websites and brand assets inside your own design system while teammates edit alongside it. Agent actions show up live on the canvas, and it comes as a web app and a Mac download. The free plan includes unlimited editors and viewers, three files and 200 agent actions a day; Pro is $16 per editor a month billed yearly.
- [SnapVivid](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/snapvivid.html) (added 2026-11-15): SnapVivid is an AI creative studio that turns a still photo into a short cinematic video, with models such as Seedance 2 for image-to-video, frames-to-video from a start and end frame, Nano Banana photo editing, AI music and voiceover tools under one credit wallet. You can start free without a card, and paid plans from $29 a month (or $17 billed yearly) add more credits, brand kits and commercial rights.
- [TalkingAvatarAI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/talkingavatarai.html) (added 2026-11-15): TalkingAvatarAI turns a single photo into a talking or singing video: you choose a face, add a script for text-to-speech or upload your own audio, and it animates the lips and expressions to match. It also offers spokesperson and music-video modes, shows each model's limits and credit cost before you generate, supports more than 20 interface languages and gives new accounts 20 free trial credits, with paid credit packs after that.
- [VidSnappy](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/vidsnappy.html) (added 2026-11-15): VidSnappy is a browser-based video toolkit that needs no signup for the basics: compress, convert, crop and trim videos, turn clips into GIFs or extract MP3 audio. Paid credit plans (from $12 a month) unlock AI tools including transcription, video background removal, a clip maker and a watermark-free editor, with free exports carrying a small VidSnappy watermark.
- [Speedbot](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/speedbot.html) (added 2026-11-15): Speedbot is a marketplace where AI agents sell skills, workflows, datasets and pay-per-call APIs to people and to other agents, with MCP and A2A access and USDC payments on Base and Arc. Buyers can read each offer's preview, version, license and price without an account or wallet, for example inspecting a website-audit kit's checks before buying the download, and agents can also be hired for a defined result or list their own products.
- [PlushSource](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/plushsource.html) (added 2026-11-15): PlushSource is an independent, facts-only directory of 55 custom plush toy manufacturers compiled from each factory's own website, with minimum order quantities, lead times, OEM/ODM services, certifications and accepted design files, browsable by country. Its open MIT-licensed MCP server (npm plushsource-mcp) lets Claude and other AI assistants search and compare the same listings, and manufacturers can be added or corrected through GitHub.
- [Scam Mirror](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/scam-mirror.html) (added 2026-11-15): Scam Mirror is an AI scam checker for one suspicious case at a time: you upload up to five photos or chat screenshots, and it looks for visible warning signs such as altered images, identity misuse, phishing links and familiar pressure tactics. Instead of a bare yes or no it returns an explainable risk assessment that lists what it found and what to verify before you reply, pay or share anything.
- [KnowLoop](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/knowloop.html) (added 2026-11-15): KnowLoop is a free spaced-repetition planner for your own study notes. You save what you learned with a title and notes, optionally generate AI flashcards from them and check the cards, and it schedules seven fixed reviews (after 20 minutes, then 1, 2, 4, 7, 15 and 30 days) with an email reminder when each one is due. Notes-only topics get the same schedule, and an account keeps your topics and completion history.
- [API Indonesia](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/api-indonesia.html) (added 2026-11-15): API Indonesia is a remote MCP server and REST API for Indonesian public data drawn from official sources: administrative regions down to villages with postal codes, national holidays and joint leave days, prayer times for 514 cities and regencies, BMKG earthquake and weather warnings, schools, campuses, hospitals, trademarks, Bank Indonesia exchange rates and minimum wages. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients connect with OAuth 2.1 or an API key, and new accounts get 3,000 free credits.
- [MOVO](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/movo.html) (added 2026-11-15): MOVO Community Edition is a self-hosted enterprise agent platform that takes DeepSeek Harness agents from experiments into production. It wraps the DSH runtime, skills, tools and MCP ecosystem in a deployable workspace with enterprise knowledge bases, deep research, content generation, vibe coding and browser automation, plus identity and access control, admin consoles, governance and file delivery. It starts locally with Docker in about five minutes.
- [Baize](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/baize.html) (added 2026-11-15): Baize is an MIT-licensed coding agent CLI for vibe coding and data analysis built around privacy. Sensitive values such as keys, names and IDs are swapped for placeholders before anything is sent to the model and restored in the response, so secrets never leave your machine. It supports DeepSeek, OpenAI-compatible, Zhipu, Tongyi, Kimi and local Ollama backends, with tool calling, skill loading, subagent delegation, context compression, a sandbox and a Docker build.
- [HunterCode Community](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/huntercode-community.html) (added 2026-11-15): HunterCode Community Edition is an Apache-2.0, self-hosted multi-agent investment research terminal for China A-shares, Hong Kong and US stocks, positioned as a local alternative to Tencent WorkBuddy's finance edition. It bundles 20 MCP services with 69 tools and 22 finance skills for market data, technical indicators, fundamentals and research reports, runs inference with your own model keys, keeps positions and conversations on your own machine and deploys with docker compose.
- [anymove](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/anymove.html) (added 2026-11-15): anymove is an Apache-2.0 pipeline from Patch that turns one AI-generated video into a motion-capture animation for any rigged creature, including wings, tails and many legs. A video model films the creature from front and side in the same frame, a DINOv2-based joint reader trained on that creature finds every joint in both views, and the rig is fitted frame by frame and exported as GLB. The repo includes agent skills to run it, and Patch says a usable move costs about $3.
- [HyperGrok Trading Desk](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/hypergrok-trading-desk.html) (added 2026-11-15): HyperGrok Trading Desk is an MIT-licensed setup that gives AI agents a shared process for researching, sizing, executing and reviewing trades on Hyperliquid. It ships seven role profiles, seventeen skills and read-only Python market tools that work without keys, and runs in Grok Bot, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and Grok Build. Live trading only happens with your own API wallet, verified approval controls and an exact ticket you approve.
- [Crucible](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/crucible.html) (added 2026-11-15): Crucible (formerly 67js) is an MIT-licensed JavaScript 3D engine that AI agents drive through an MCP server. A scene is plain data, so an agent can build it, light it, check previews and render it, while you keep the creative decisions and get asked when a matter of taste is open. It includes a real-time rasterizer, a path tracer and addons for terrain, vegetation, characters, liquids, vehicles and media export, and finished scenes open live in the browser.
- [WebRouter](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/webrouter.html) (added 2026-11-15): WebRouter is an Apache-2.0 open standard and SDK from Nimble that gives AI agents one typed interface for web access: search, page extraction, live data, answers, deep research, site-specific scrapers and browser control. It works across many web-data providers with your own keys, routes each task by cost, latency and coverage, and keeps the call and result shape the same when you switch vendors, with governance controls for provider choice, scoped keys and explicit opt-in for writes.
- [Agents Universe](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/agents-universe.html) (added 2026-11-15): Agents Universe is an Apache-2.0, self-hosted enterprise AI agent platform built to make agents work like team members: they onboard by reading project documents, plan before acting, run tasks under a person's own identity and permissions, leave an auditable trail and turn what they learn into reusable skills, workflows and knowledge. It connects multiple LLMs, ships 10 ready-made agents, deploys with docker compose, and the public instance is maintained by its own Product Owner and Tech Lead agents.
- [InferenceX](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/inferencex.html) (added 2026-11-15): InferenceX is SemiAnalysis' open-source inference research platform that continuously benchmarks how fast and how efficiently AI models are served on different accelerators and software stacks. It runs end-to-end serving benchmarks for new models from day zero on NVIDIA B200, B300 and GB200 and AMD MI355X systems with vLLM and SGLang, adds networking, kernel and hardware microbenchmarks, measures power draw, and publishes results on inferencex.com. Apache 2.0.
- [Tons of Skills](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/tons-of-skills.html) (added 2026-11-15): Tons of Skills is an MIT-licensed marketplace and package manager for agent skills and plugins from Intent Solutions. It publishes a large, searchable catalog of skills, agents and slash commands at tonsofskills.com and installs them with the ccpi CLI from npm. Skills are written in a harness-neutral canonical format with verified adapters; Claude Code is the fully supported target today, and other agents are marked as candidates until their integration is verified.
- [Apache Pinot](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/apache-pinot.html) (added 2026-11-15): Apache Pinot is an Apache-2.0 real-time OLAP database built to answer analytical SQL queries in milliseconds over fresh streaming and batch data, at very high query concurrency. It ingests from Kafka, Pulsar or Kinesis and from object storage, supports star-tree and other indexes, upserts and joins, and adds vector search, which makes it a backend for user-facing analytics and for agents that need fast, structured answers over live data. It runs self-managed or as a managed service from vendors such as StarTree.
- [ReLE Chinese LLM Benchmark](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/rele-chinese-llm-benchmark.html) (added 2026-11-15): ReLE (formerly CLiB) is NoneLinear's continuously updated benchmark of how well large language models handle Chinese, covering more than 400 commercial and open models such as GPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok, Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM and ERNIE. Models are scored across about 300 dimensions in seven domains including education, medicine, finance, law, reasoning and math, instruction following, and agents and tool calling, and the project also publishes a defect library of over two million failure cases.
- [dsh-TUI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/dsh-tui.html) (added 2026-11-15): dsh-TUI is an MIT-licensed interactive terminal interface for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), the open coding-agent harness. It adds a pixel-whale header, live work status, streaming model thinking, a context progress bar, a tokens-per-second gauge, split diff cards and double-Esc time rewind, plus a todo side panel and smooth mouse interaction. It installs from npm with one command, uses only DSH's public exports and leaves no patches behind when removed.
- [Tick Stock Panel (TSP)](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/tick-stock-panel-tsp.html) (added 2026-11-15): TSP (Tick Stock Panel) is a self-hosted, MIT-licensed quant workbench for China A-shares that runs in a single Docker container with no external database. You write or customize strategies with help from an LLM assistant, scan the whole market in milliseconds with a Polars engine, run backtests and factor mining, and monitor positions in a React dashboard, with data sources as plugins and every capability exposed as an API. The author stresses it is a research tool, not investment advice or a stock-picking app.
- [AIHOT](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/aihot.html) (added 2026-11-15): AIHOT is the open-source engine behind the aihot.news AI news site: it pulls items from a list of sources every day, has an LLM pre-filter them, scores the likely-important ones twice independently, writes Chinese headlines and summaries, clusters reports of the same event and ranks them by how widely they are discussed, then publishes a daily brief. All prompts and selection thresholds are in the repo, so you can swap in your own sources and criteria to run a hot-topics site for any industry. MIT licensed, with an MCP endpoint for agents.
- [Hummingbot](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/hummingbot.html) (added 2026-11-15): Hummingbot is an Apache-2.0 framework for designing and running automated crypto trading bots on centralized and decentralized exchanges. You pick or script a strategy (market making, arbitrage, directional and more), connect exchange API keys and run it locally or in Docker, with connectors for 140+ trading venues. The community says its users have generated over $34 billion in trading volume, and the project adds AI-agent tooling and an MCP server for strategy automation.
- [RuView](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/ruview.html) (added 2026-11-15): RuView is an MIT-licensed sensing system that turns ordinary WiFi signals into spatial awareness without cameras or wearables: it detects people, tracks movement and estimates breathing and heart rate room by room, even through walls and in the dark. It runs on low-cost ESP32 hardware, exposes presence and vitals to Home Assistant, Apple Home, Google Home and Alexa through MQTT, HAP or Matter, and ships an AI toolkit and trained models for building your own sensing apps.
- [Terminal Browser](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/terminal-browser.html) (added 2026-11-14): terminal-browser runs a real web browser inside your terminal, rendering pages through terminals with kitty graphics support, so you can browse in a split pane beside your shell or route requests through a remote server over SSH. It installs with curl or Homebrew on macOS and Linux (WSL on Windows) and ships a Claude Code plugin so a coding agent can open and inspect pages in the same terminal. MIT.
- [Nuphos](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/nuphos.html) (added 2026-11-14): Nuphos is an Apache-2.0, open-source alternative to Grok Bot for teams: always-on bots that run on the Claude Code or Codex subscription you already pay for, on a managed cloud computer or a machine you own, in chats your whole team can join. Teammates share the same live session, see every tool call and steer a bot together, and a bot keeps working after you close your laptop, with an iOS app to pick it up. Not affiliated with xAI.
- [Axiomcodegraph](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/axiomcodegraph.html) (added 2026-11-14): AxiomCode Graph turns a repository into a knowledge graph built with formal methods: for every function it derives exactly who calls it and what it calls, including calls through interfaces and subclasses that grep misses. Coding agents then explore, search and edit from that map to see what each change breaks, saving time and tokens. It runs locally with a CLI.
- [Tavotto](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/tavotto.html) (added 2026-11-14): Tavotto makes AI-drawn research figures publication-ready: it opens a figure produced by an AI assistant or your own matplotlib script, lets you edit titles, legends, curves and multi-panel page layout in millimetres on a canvas while the script stays untouched, and checks the result against a journal profile (font size floor, column width, dpi) before export. Free and AGPL-3.0, for macOS, Windows and Linux (PyPI beta).
- [LoopForge](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/loopforge.html) (added 2026-11-14): LoopForge is Tencent's self-hosted, MIT-licensed workspace for shipping software with coding agents: you describe a requirement to its Main Bot in chat, and it opens a Docker sandbox, checks out your repositories, delegates to project roles and opens the pull request. Proven ways of working are saved as SOPs that combine agents, scripts and human approval gates, and it drives CLIs such as CodeBuddy, Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and Cursor CLI.
- [Wu](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/wu.html) (added 2026-11-14): Wu is a fast native code editor and agent workspace written in Rust, a heavily diverged fork of Zed that renders on the GPU with a lower memory footprint than VS Code. Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode are built in as coding agents, there is no account or telemetry, and it installs on macOS, Windows and Linux.
- [Vork](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/vork.html) (added 2026-11-14): vork is a headless 3D and VFX engine built for AI agents: the agent writes the whole scene as code, including its own shaders, materials, cameras and physics, and vork renders it on the GPU through a core API of about 2,500 tokens. Written in Rust and Slang for Vulkan and Metal, it benchmarks faster than Blender EEVEE, and vork cloud renders on Voyager's GPUs if you have none. Research preview.
- [Yomo](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/yomo.html) (added 2026-11-14): YoMo is an open-source LLM function-calling framework for building fast, scalable AI agents: you deploy tools as serverless functions, and its geo-distributed edge infrastructure runs them close to users over QUIC with TLS 1.3 on every packet. It streamlines the lifecycle of LLM tools from development to deployment and supports strongly typed functions in TypeScript and Go.
- [Qualitylayer](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/qualitylayer.html) (added 2026-11-14): QualityLayer is a workflow layer for coding agents that keeps you in the loop: your agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others, on your existing login) drafts a plan with diagrams and clickable screens for you to approve, then writes tests before code, splits independent parts across agents and verifies each small change. You work in its desktop app, the browser or your own terminal, IDE or agent app.
- [Raea](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/raea.html) (added 2026-11-14): raea (Render Anything Engine) lets your AI make videos, motion graphics, 3D scenes and games written as React and TypeScript, then renders them on your own GPU faster than real time with a Rust and Bevy engine. The installer adds raea's agent skills to Claude Code, and a desktop app for macOS, Linux and Windows shows previews and exports. v0.1 is an early release.
- [Mlx Serve](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/mlx-serve.html) (added 2026-11-14): MLX-Serve runs open models on Apple Silicon Macs from one native app and one local server that speaks the OpenAI, Anthropic and Ollama APIs, so chat apps and coding agents like Claude Code can use local models. Beyond chat it generates images, video, music, speech and 3D, works offline with no Python or account, suggests a model that fits your Mac and installs via download or Homebrew (macOS 26.2+).
- [KiCAD-MCP-Server](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/kicad-mcp-server.html) (added 2026-11-14): KiCAD MCP Server is an MIT-licensed Model Context Protocol server that lets Claude and other LLM clients drive KiCad for printed circuit board design: creating projects and schematics, placing and moving components, routing traces, running design-rule checks and exporting fabrication files from natural-language instructions. Its successor, Konnect-EDA at Orchis.ai, is a native KiCad 10 plugin with 228 tools and bundled skills for Claude and Codex.
- [Locally Uncensored](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/locally-uncensored.html) (added 2026-11-14): Locally Uncensored is a free AGPL-3.0 desktop studio that puts local AI chat, image generation, video generation and a coding agent in one app: you install it, pick a model and run everything on your own machine with no Docker, terminal or config files. It targets Windows and Linux and works fully offline in local mode.
- [Omniget](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/omniget.html) (added 2026-11-14): OmniGet is a local MCP server that gives coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI a desktop toolbox: downloads from YouTube, torrents and every site yt-dlp supports, media conversion, file handling, chat exports and system cleanup, all running on your own machine. You connect an agent with one pasted line and approve it with a short code, and sensitive actions wait for your click. GPL-3.0, for Windows, macOS and Linux.
- [WeClone](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/weclone.html) (added 2026-11-14): WeClone distills your identity, goals, preferences and current situation from your chat history and other digital records into a reviewable life portrait organized by domains such as work, family and health, where every fact traces back to its source. That portrait serves as long-term memory for your personal assistants and can power a clone that writes in your own style. Extraction runs through Codex or any OpenAI-compatible API. AGPL-3.0.
- [FinceptTerminal](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/finceptterminal.html) (added 2026-11-14): Fincept Terminal is an AGPL-3.0 desktop finance terminal for market analytics, investment research and economic data, with multi-agent AI research, portfolio tools, backtesting and data from hundreds of sources in one interface. The open-source edition is free; a paid Enterprise edition adds real-time data, live broker and algorithmic execution and priority support from $15 per user a month.
- [PDFMathTranslate](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/pdfmathtranslate.html) (added 2026-11-14): PDFMathTranslate (pdf2zh) translates scientific PDFs while keeping the original layout: formulas, charts, tables of contents and annotations stay in place and it outputs bilingual or translated-only files. It works with Google, DeepL, OpenAI, Ollama and other translation services, adds experimental OCR and an ultrafast mode for native-text PDFs, and runs as a CLI, a desktop or web GUI, Docker, an MCP server or a Zotero plugin. AGPL-3.0; an EMNLP 2025 demo paper.
- [AskMed](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/askmed.html) (added 2026-11-14): AskMed answers medical questions with cited sources: you ask about a condition, drug, interaction or guideline and get a clear answer that links to the journal articles, clinical guidelines and drug labels it relies on, plus a research mode for deeper literature work. It is built for physicians, nurses, pharmacists and medical students, on the web and iOS.
- [contracts.io](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/contracts-io.html) (added 2026-11-14): contracts.io drafts a contract from one sentence: its assistant Lex writes a plain-English agreement such as a statement of work for England and Wales, you send a single link, and the other side reads, counters clause by clause with tracked redlines and e-signs without an account or fee. Lex also explains contracts you have been sent. The free plan covers three active contracts; Plus (£15/month) adds unlimited contracts and templates.
- [AI Rap Video.cc](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/ai-rap-video-cc.html) (added 2026-11-14): AI Rap Video.cc turns one or two portrait photos into a short AI rap performance with vocals and music, set in a studio, street or party scene, or recasts a reference clip with your faces in Video Remix. You choose the video model (Seedance, Wan or Kling) and resolution, and credits are refunded when a run is blocked; one-time credit packs start at $9.99.
- [Zambo](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/zambo.html) (added 2026-11-14): Zambo is a hosted MCP server and verifiable work layer for AI, created by Brennan Zambo: one URL (zambo.dev/mcp) adds 153 tools, 37 of them on the default surface, to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code or Grok with no key or signup. It keeps a job's notes so another chat or another AI can pick the work up, and every job produces an AER-1 receipt, an open agent-execution receipt format published as an IETF draft, that anyone can check. Every tool is free once a day; a $0.99 day pass or a $29 30-day pass unlocks unlimited use.
- [EverygenAI Photo to Sketch](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/everygenai-photo-to-sketch.html) (added 2026-11-14): EverygenAI Photo to Sketch turns a single portrait or object photo into a clean pencil drawing with defined contours and natural graphite shading, from light line art to a fully shaded study. You upload a PNG, JPG or WebP up to 10 MB, optionally describe the style, pick a model and generate; the page also explains how to choose sources with clear edges and simple backgrounds for better sketches. Generations use credits.
- [EveryGen AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/everygen-ai.html) (added 2026-11-14): EveryGen AI is a web video studio that puts models such as Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0 Turbo, Veo 3.1, MiniMax and Grok Imagine behind one prompt box for text-to-video and image-to-video, plus trend templates for viral dances and memes. Its Marketing Studio turns a product photo into a UGC-style ad, unboxing, product-hero or before-and-after video with captions and lip-synced creators, and it includes a 4K image generator.
- [Prizm](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/prizm.html) (added 2026-11-14): Prizm tailors your CV and cover letter to each job: you add your CV once as Word, PDF or a photo, paste a job link or text, and it first gives an honest assessment of your chances with real strengths and gaps, then rewrites both documents for that role in your own Word layout or one of five templates. You review every change and nothing is invented; the first check is free with no card.
- [Pumli](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/pumli.html) (added 2026-11-14): Pumli is a private AI companion for iPhone and iPad that runs local language models on the device, up to 35B parameters on compatible hardware, so chats and dictation work offline and stay on the phone. When you choose, it connects to Notion, GitHub, Exa, Context7, Calendar, Messages, Reminders and Health, drafts email, researches with sources and makes AI images and video through online providers, with memories you can review and edit.
- [LoraAI Pro](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/loraai-pro.html) (added 2026-11-14): LoraAI Pro is a LoRA image and video generator: you browse a directory of community LoRA models for SDXL, Qwen Image and other bases, generate with one in the browser, or train your own LoRA on reference photos to keep a character, style or product consistent across images and videos. It also supports reference-photo editing and API workflows.
- [Agent Garrett](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/agent-garrett.html) (added 2026-11-14): Agent Garrett is a personal cybersecurity agent that hunts down your exposed personal information across data-broker sites, files and tracks removal requests, monitors your identity and websites, and checks suspicious texts, emails, links or screenshots you bring it. Work runs as scheduled agent tasks with evidence you can review, and it exposes MCP and API access. The Agent plan is US$4.99 a month.
- [MemeBoing](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/memeboing.html) (added 2026-11-14): MemeBoing turns a single photo into a six-second vertical meme video: you pick a trending template, such as a dance, a dramatic entrance or a two-person comedy bit, upload a face, and it animates you into the scene with no prompt and no watermark. Templates cover solo, friends and pet scenes; browsing is free and each video uses credits.
- [WaveXML](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/wavexml.html) (added 2026-11-14): WaveXML syncs multi-camera footage and separate Zoom or Sound Devices audio recorders by sound, working from timelines exported by DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro or Final Cut and sending synced XML back. Version 2.0 lets your own Claude, ChatGPT (Codex) or Cursor cut a first edit inside the app: it measures every shot for shake, focus and exposure, follows your saved editing rules and hands over a switchable multicam. Footage stays on your Mac or Windows PC; the beta is free.
- [Lium](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/lium.html) (added 2026-11-14): Lium is a GPU marketplace built for agent-driven compute: an agent installs the CLI, starts a pod with one command such as lium up --gpu H100 --ttl 1h, runs its job and has the pod removed automatically within the budget you set. It lists RTX 5090 to H100, H200, B200 and B300 machines from many providers with per-second billing, spot pricing, volumes, backups, a Python SDK and an API.
- [Movmix](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/movmix.html) (added 2026-11-14): Movmix is an AI video and image studio with pre-tuned templates, so you get cinematic clips without prompt engineering: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video extend, AI dance and product-ad generators run on models such as Kling, Seedance, Wan, MiniMax and GPT Images. It covers ad templates for product shots, anime-to-video and image tools like upscaling, with an Android app.
- [Corint AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/corint-ai.html) (added 2026-11-14): Corint is an agentic risk-operations platform for banks, lenders, fintechs, insurers and payment companies: AI agents monitor connected business data, detect rising risk, investigate root causes and prepare candidate strategy changes, which are tested, validated and approved by people before Corint's decision engine runs them in production. Its three products, Work, Intelligence and Decision, keep data, policies and decision history in one governed loop. Pricing is by demo.
- [ComVise AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/comvise-ai.html) (added 2026-11-14): ComVise AI (商图策 AI) is a product-image workspace for e-commerce sellers: upload a flat-lay garment or product photo and it generates on-model shots, pose variations, a full nine-image product-detail set and short product videos, treating the garment's outline, print and stitching as a locked layer so the clothes are not redrawn. It also upscales, retouches and removes watermarks, charges roughly ¥0.2–0.4 per image with no subscription, and offers a REST API and MCP server for batch pipelines.
- [SandBase](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/sandbase.html) (added 2026-11-14): SandBase gives an AI agent one account and one API key for LLMs, image and video models, live data APIs (search, social and company data) and a code sandbox, so it can fetch data, call models and run Python in the same pay-per-call workflow. It adds Skills and ready-made agents, can be added to Claude Code in one step, and starts with 100 free API calls a day and no card.
- [AgentPawn](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/agentpawn.html) (added 2026-11-14): AgentPawn is a free job board where AI agents post work for other agents and pick it up: jobs in categories such as code, research, data, writing and verification can be posted, browsed, claimed, completed and reopened entirely through its API, and agents discuss results in comment threads. Claims are time-boxed, so an agent registers, takes a task, does it and submits proof without a human in the loop.
- [Qstudy AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/qstudy-ai.html) (added 2026-11-14): Qstudy AI is a study companion for college students: you drop in a lecture PDF, an audio recording or just a topic, and it returns the material as structured notes, adaptive quizzes, flashcards, an animated explainer, a study plan or even a revision song, in your own language. It offers 18 output formats with streaks and progress tracking, a free account without a card and a cancel-anytime Premium plan.
- [Priorivo](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/priorivo.html) (added 2026-11-14): Priorivo is a read-only technical SEO and indexability checker that crawls up to 100 public pages of a site, opens ten selected pages on desktop and mobile, and returns the few issues worth fixing first, each with the exact URL, the HTML evidence it observed and a recommended next step. People can run a free scan without signing up; AI agents can order the same check through its remote MCP server at getpriorivo.com/mcp or a REST/n8n workflow for €9.90 per site, buyer-approved, and get the findings back as private JSON. Setup and a free preview are documented at getpriorivo.com/developers/agents.
- [Diagnosed by AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/diagnosed-by-ai.html) (added 2026-11-14): Diagnosed by AI is a public board where people post a health question or symptom pattern as an open case and registered AI agents answer it with educational opinions: possible conditions to raise with a clinician, questions worth asking and general next steps. Several agents can answer the same case, humans add context in a separately labeled discussion, and developers connect their own agent through a documented REST API with an instant API key. Every answer is labeled AI-generated opinion, not a diagnosis.

## Launches and status

- [How AgentScout started](https://agentscouthq.com/how-it-started.html): founder-run, mostly automated with AI agents. @clampdown19 (m lk) makes the calls.
- [Weekly launch board](https://agentscouthq.com/launches/): tools added each ISO week (Pacific), with server-side upvotes.
- [MCP server status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/status/): up, down, and not-yet-checked counts. Updated daily, around 7 AM PT.
- The $99 weekly sponsorship includes submissions to about 25 other AI directories, with a report of the links. Refunds: https://agentscouthq.com/refunds.html
- Fast-Track ($15) includes: Same-day indexing ping to Bing and IndexNow search engines (does not include Google).

## Community Grok Bot templates

- [PR Reviewer](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-pr-reviewer): Reviews pull requests for risk, missing tests, and thin context so review starts with the scary diff. Leads with what can break, what is untested.
- [Agent Looper](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-agent-looper): You say what to build and how to know it's done. It keeps a coding agent working on your computer until that check passes.
- [Examiner](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-examiner): Maintain a reliable timeline of important changes so you can reconstruct what happened when something later goes wrong. Isolated: talk only to you.
- [AI Harness Assistant](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-ai-harness-assistant): Keeps the AI coding tools you already have, like Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Cursor, current on your Windows, Mac, and Linux machines.
- [GreenBuild](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-greenbuild): A senior QA and test-automation lead for testers and dev teams. It turns requirements into test plans and triages flaky tests.
